evaluation.dev: EXP-09-001 dev questions (G4 vs the cached G0 / G3 answers): sanity check only, no selection
evaluation.seen_test: EXP-09-001 test questions: SEEN (the error analysis read them), reported as seen; human-written reference statements

drug_questions: What are the common side effects of {drug}?
fresh_test.metrics: CliniVer verification of every answer (baseline v2): share of claims Supported / Contradicted; drug naming on the treatment questions; non-answers

round2.adoption: G4 replaces G0 in the service if ALL hold: (a) seen test: reference_contradiction ≤ G0 + 0.02 and reference_recall ≥ G0 − 0.01 (point estimates; CIs reported); (b) fresh test: verified Contradicted share ≤ G0 + 0.02 and verified Supported share ≥ G0 − 0.02; (c) drug naming on all treatment questions ≥ G0's
